newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France drains 2.8 bln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France drains 2.8 bln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France drained 2.8 billion francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Thursday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Friday.
It accepted bids for 41.0 billion francs in new liquidity, 2.8 billion less than the 43.8 billion leaving the market on Friday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on September 27.
The Bank of France said it allocated 11.9 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 3.0 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 29.1 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 11.7 percent of this demand.
